label: reset gate drops with unrewarded-trial streaks, most at GO and after S1 losses
terms: (phase == D1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (1 + (tv("reward", -3) == 0)) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_reward==0) * (prev_state==1) ;; (prev_reward == 0) * ep_trial / 100 ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward==1) * (prev_state==2)
explanation: Raw reset gate r19 sits near 0.95 and is lowered by recent unrewarded trials. After an unrewarded trial it drops at GO (strongest, about -0.06 to -0.2) and at D2. The drop gets deeper with consecutive losses (the trial before, and the one before that), is larger when the lost trial reached S1 (a1 S1 u is the deepest cell), and grows later in the episode. One reward resets it quickly; GO after a rewarded S2 trial is slightly raised. At D1 the gate lags by one trial: it reflects the outcome of the trial before last (tv reward -2) and not yet the reward input shown at that D1. The upcoming choice, hidden good state and value add little; a policy-confidence term at GO added only ~0.006. Observed-only terms: test R^2 beyond timing 0.589 (dev 0.592) against an all-cue ceiling of 0.66 (all observed 0.63).

issues: Core claims check out on test. Dropping the S1-loss term lowers R^2 from 0.589 to 0.523, dropping the ep_trial term lowers it to 0.551, and adding (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==0) adds only 0.002. That confirms the D1 one-trial lag. A streak term for a fourth loss in a row adds nothing (0.589), so the claim that the drop deepens with each extra loss only holds up to about 3 losses in the terms.

Claim 'GO after a rewarded S2 trial is slightly raised' is too narrow. The profile residuals at GO are a1 S2 r +0.061, a2 S2 r +0.076 and a2 S1 r +0.059, but a1 S1 r only +0.021. So GO is raised after any rewarded trial except a1->S1, not only after S2. Swapping the term for (phase==GO)*(prev_reward==1)*(1-last_is('a1 S1 r')) raises test R^2 from 0.618 to 0.629 (with the a1 S1 u term below in place). misses also shows 'GO after a2 S1 r' under-predicted by +0.037.

Systematic miss: the deepest cell, GO after a1 S1 u, is over-predicted (actual - predicted = -0.062). The real residual there is -0.196, against -0.116 for a2 S1 u. So the effect is specific to the a1 -> S1 (common) path, not just to 'reached S1'. Adding (phase==GO)*last_is('a1 S1 u') alone raises test R^2 from 0.589 to 0.616.

A smaller leftover asymmetry by previous choice remains in every phase: a1 cells are over-predicted (D1 after a1 S2 r -0.025, D2 after a1 S1 u -0.029) and a2 cells under-predicted (D2 after a2 S1 u +0.032, GO after a2 S2 u +0.029).
Minor: a GO policy-confidence term (phase==GO)*abs(choice) adds 0.011 on test (0.589 -> 0.600), not the 0.006 the explanation states.
